neet_phy_u11_t14_1.working: Filling the gap with a dielectric multiplies C by K, so C = 4 × 5 pF = 20 pF.

neet_phy_u11_t14_2.working: C' = ε0A/(d - t + t/K) with t = d/2 and K = 2, giving ε0A/(d/2 + d/4) = (4/3)ε0A/d. So C' = (4/3) × 6 μF = 8 μF.

neet_phy_u11_t14_3.working: Battery is disconnected, so Q is constant. C becomes 3C, so V = 90/3 = 30 V and U = Q²/2C = 270/3 = 90 μJ.

neet_phy_u11_t14_4.working: With the battery connected V is constant. C becomes KC, so Q = CV becomes KQ. A is true and R correctly explains it.

neet_phy_u11_t14_5.working: I: side-by-side dielectrics act in parallel, C = ε0(A/2)K1/d + ε0(A/2)K2/d = ε0A(K1+K2)/2d, so I is correct. II: stacked layers act in series, each Ci = 2Kiε0A/d. The series combination is 2ε0AK1K2/[d(K1+K2)], so II is correct.
